fields.FIR_Description: According to the complaint registered on 2025-10-09, the spouse of the complainant, Inban Selvam, aged 42, left for college and did not return; the last known location was near Vaigai Nagar College Road. The incident is stated to have occurred on 2025-10-08 at about 18:40. The complaint was lodged by Sanjay Raj (9000000083), a family member of Inban Selvam, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000182. Nithin Thangaraj (9000000252) was mentioned as a person who was present nearby. A further person, Praveen Sekar, a friend of the suspect, using the number 9000000221, is stated to be associated with the incident. The complainant could not identify the person involved. The complainant mentioned CCTV footage and social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone reportedly switched off after the last known call.
fields.Keywords: missing person, adult, college road, evening, witness, associate, CCTV, screenshot
